text: Weeks after go-live, Devon Okafor stands in front of Marisol Fontaine and Service leadership to present the finished warranty-claims system -- real adoption, honestly, visibility gap included.
Warranty_Claim__c is live, auto-routing every claim, and in daily use by about 150 people across Sales and Service. That's the real win, stated first.
The wrinkle: Hannah Reyes and Tobias Lindgren were placed as Role Hierarchy peers of their own reps, not above them, so their dashboards showed almost none of their own team's claims.
Found through two managers independently reporting the same problem, fixed by correcting the hierarchy -- the sharing rule itself never needed to change.
Next: following a claim out of Setup and into an actual day on Hannah's and Tobias's teams.
